## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit / property / golden as relevant)
- [ ] Numbers reconciled by the Finance owner against `docs/methodology.md`
- [ ] If a calculation changed: ID/version bumped in `registry.ts`, `pnpm docs:generate` run
- [ ] If data changed: `pnpm data:generate` run and fixtures committed
- [ ] `docs/assumptions-log.md` updated if a simplification was introduced
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added
- [ ] Preview deployment reviewed
- [ ] Touches recommendations or approvals: audit trail verified
- [ ] No secrets, real company data or personal data committed
